title.narrative: Strengthening the UNESCO Water family in South-East Europe

description.narrative: This initiative will strengthen cooperation among water experts, institutions, universities, and decision-makers across South-East Europe to address growing challenges related to water resources, climate change, floods, droughts, and ecosystem health. It will create opportunities for regional dialogue, knowledge exchange, and practical learning while promoting the use of science in decision-making. Key activities include a regional consultation meeting, tailored training programmes, peer-learning exchanges, and the development of knowledge products showcasing good practices and innovative solutions. The initiative will also foster collaboration among countries on shared water challenges and support the next generation of water professionals. Expected deliverables include a regional cooperation roadmap, training events, thematic knowledge exchanges, and policy-oriented publications that strengthen water management, climate resilience, and sustainable development across the region.
